_README: Copy this to ~/.dast-ai/subapp_map.json and fill in YOUR target's sub-app topology. It maps a request-path prefix to the internal service that serves it, the JWT field that service's Bearer lives under in GET /spa/session (user.attributes.<jwt_field>), and a probe endpoint to prove the token. It is target-specific internal topology, so it is NEVER committed (the repo ships only this generic example). With no local file, sub-app Bearer selection is disabled and Frieren falls back to host-level Bearer selection. 'prefix' and 'probe' are optional.
